profile.name: Bista Kaji
profile.tagline: Mountains, maps, mathematics, and clear explanation.
profile.intro: I am a Mathematics and Physics tutor, GIS analyst, and MSc Mountain and Mountaineering Science student. My work explores Himalayan hazards, rivers, and landscapes while helping students build genuine confidence in mathematics.

posts.body: A trail is more than a route between places. It reveals slope stability, drainage patterns, settlement choices, and the practical decisions people make to live with steep and dynamic terrain.
posts.imageCaption: A footbridge along a Nepal trekking trail.
posts.title: What a trail teaches about terrain

posts.body: Flood susceptibility mapping does not predict a specific flood. Instead, it helps identify where terrain, drainage, rainfall, and land cover combine to make flooding more likely.
posts.imageCaption: Illustrative flood map used as a placeholder.
posts.title: Seeing flood risk before the water arrives

posts.body: Himalayan rivers carry a record of altitude, glacier melt, monsoon rainfall, and geological change.
posts.imageCaption: A Himalayan river valley and mountain settlement.
posts.title: Rivers, ice, and the memory of mountains

research.methods: QGIS, DEM terrain analysis, raster normalisation, AHP, MCDA, land-cover analysis, drainage analysis, and map classification.
research.outcome: A classified flood-susceptibility surface identifying relatively higher-risk areas for preliminary planning attention.
research.summary: A GIS-based AHP/MCDA study combining terrain, rainfall, drainage, land cover, and hydrological indicators.
research.title: Flood Susceptibility Mapping of Lalitpur District

research.imageCaption: High-mountain landscape placeholder for the Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi study area.
research.methods: Literature synthesis, event chronology, geospatial context, and critical evaluation of evidence.
research.outcome: A cause-focused analysis distinguishing established mechanisms from unresolved hypotheses.
research.summary: Research on slope instability, debris flows, permafrost, and cascade hazards behind the August 2026 flood.
research.title: Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi Flood Event, August 2026

research.imageCaption: Himalayan river-valley placeholder for basin hydrology research.
research.methods: Comparative basin analysis using hydrological and climate data.
research.outcome: Insight into how mountain processes influence downstream river systems.
research.summary: Comparative analysis of discharge, glacial melt, monsoon precipitation, and seasonal water availability.
research.title: River-Basin Hydrology in Nepal
